title: ALRMElec_Smoke Detector Test Noise In Small Room_ladako_room reflections.wav by ladako
description:
Smoke detector test noise, recorded in a small room, roughly 2m from mic. The mic is pointing into the room, only capturing room reflections.
Fundamental frequency: ca. 3374 Hz
Overtones: ca. 6741 Hz; 10109 HZ, 13482 Hz

Feel free to use this sound; no attribution required.
Feel free to write me in the comments what you used this sound for.

RØDE NTG2
Sound Devices MixPre-3 II

Mono
48 kHz
24-bit
